## What does this change?

## Type

- [ ] Fix (typo, broken link, wording)
- [ ] Correction (a claim or figure was wrong)
- [ ] New content

## Checklist

- [ ] Factual claims / numbers are cited in `docs/references.md` (and labeled directional where appropriate).
- [ ] Cross-links updated if I moved or renamed anything.
- [ ] `markdownlint` and `lychee` pass locally (or CI is green).
- [ ] Backlog in `.agentic-repo-progress.md` updated if I completed an item.
